observations: Native paper/dark and 300/600 px comparisons inspected. Exactly four rows of six faces, no text or people.
Visible cell widths 209 to 221 px; heights 190 to 205 px. Mean width/height 1.0675, so the requested identical-square grid is not achieved.
After translation only, row edge errors at 2000 px equivalent are 3.91, 5.21, 14.32 and 9.11 px. No stretching or artificial pass.
